about: Ground truth is expressed as verbatim MARKER PHRASES, never as chunk indices or ids.
A retrieved chunk counts as relevant iff it contains at least one of the question's markers,
compared with whitespace collapsed on both sides (the corpus is hard-wrapped; chunk text is
stored verbatim, so the normalisation is applied only to the comparison).
This is what makes the dataset survive its own system: changing TENANTIQ_CHUNK_TARGET_TOKENS,
re-ingesting, or swapping the extractor renumbers every chunk in the corpus, and an id-based
dataset would silently start measuring nothing. A marker is also checkable by a human reading
the source document, which an id is not.
The number of relevant chunks per question is DERIVED by scanning the ingested corpus, never
asserted here — so it cannot go stale either. A marker that matches no chunk is a hard error,
not a zero score: it means the dataset is broken, and reporting recall against an empty

questions.question: Under the current terms, how many days does the customer have to pay an invoice?
markers: within forty-five (45) days of the invoice date
questions.note: The MSA says thirty (30) days and Amendment No. 2 supersedes it. The superseded clause is a deliberate distractor sharing almost all of its vocabulary with the correct answer.

questions.question: Is there a discount for paying an invoice early?
markers: early payment discount of two percent (2%)

questions.question: What happens if the customer pays an invoice late?
markers: accrue interest at one percent (1%) per month
zero point seven five percent (0.75%) per month
questions.note: Genuinely two relevant chunks in two documents: the original rate and the rate that replaced it. Both are legitimate retrieval targets — this is one of the few questions where recall@k can exceed a single hit.

questions.question: What is the cap on each party's total liability under the agreement?
markers: total aggregate liability arising out of

questions.question: How much notice is required to terminate the agreement for convenience?
markers: terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving one hundred and twenty (120) days
questions.note: Competes with the ninety (90) day non-renewal notice in the same document and the thirty (30) day cure period beside it.

questions.question: How long is the initial term and how does the agreement renew?
markers: initial term of this Agreement is twenty-four (24) months

questions.question: How quickly must a personal data breach be notified?
markers: in any event within seventy-two (72) hours
questions.note: The security policy's fifteen-minute alert acknowledgement and one-hour incident triage are distractors: same domain, same shape of answer, different obligation.

questions.question: Which sub-processors are approved, and where do they operate?
How much notice is given before a new sub-processor is added?
markers: thirty (30) days prior written notice of any intended addition or replacement

questions.question: What is the initial response target for a Severity 1 support incident?
markers: For Severity 1 the initial response target is thirty (30) minutes
questions.note: The security policy's fifteen-minute critical-alert acknowledgement is the distractor.

questions.question: What service credit applies if monthly uptime falls below 99.5%?
markers: below 99.5% but at or above 99.0%, a credit of twenty-five percent (25%)

questions.question: When is scheduled maintenance performed?
markers: announced window of Sunday 02:00 to 06:00 UK time

questions.question: How is customer data encrypted at rest?
How is access to production systems controlled?
How long after termination is customer data deleted?
markers: delete Customer Data from production systems within sixty (60) days

questions.question: What are the default API rate limits?
markers: one hundred and twenty (120) read requests per minute

questions.question: What is the maximum I can claim for a hotel night in London?
What can I claim towards a home office?
markers: one-off home office allowance of three hundred pounds (GBP 300)

out_of_corpus.question: What is the recipe for sourdough bread?
What is the capital of Peru?
How do I reset my home wifi router to factory settings?

out_of_corpus_about: Questions the corpus cannot answer. They carry no markers and are excluded from precision,
recall and MRR — scoring them would be meaningless, because there is no correct chunk.
They exist to measure something the retrieval metrics cannot: SEPARATION. Retrieval always
returns its k nearest neighbours, however far away they are, so with the default
TENANTIQ_RETRIEVAL_MIN_SIMILARITY of 0.0 the system can never refuse. The gap between the worst
in-corpus top similarity and the best out-of-corpus top similarity is the window any usable
floor has to sit in — and if that gap is negative, no single threshold can separate the two,
which is a finding worth having rather than a number worth hiding.
